# govulncheck allowlist — OSV IDs the CI vuln gate tolerates.
#
# The CI job (.github/workflows/ci.yml :: vulncheck) FAILS on any *called*
# vulnerability whose ID is not listed here. New or unexpected vulnerabilities
# therefore break the build; the entries below are the known, accepted
# exceptions. One ID per line; any text after the ID is a free-form note
# (do NOT put other GO-IDs in a note — the parser greps every GO-ID on a line).
#
# Keep this list MINIMAL. Re-evaluate on every dependency bump and delete
# entries as fixes land. Tracking: ENG-415.
#
# ── Category A: no upstream fix available (govulncheck "Fixed in: N/A") ──────
# github.com/docker/docker @ v28.5.2+incompatible has no patched release: the
# fix ships only as moby/moby/v2 v2.0.0-beta.8, whose 22 published tags are ALL
# v2.0.0-beta.N. Unlike the daemon-only advisories dropped in ENG-639, these two
# ARE in the called set — though only via docker/client package init and
# client.Client.Close, not the plugin code the advisories describe. Keep them:
# the gate compares against the called set, so removing them would fail CI.
#
# Since ENG-642 (docker/compose v5) fred's only *direct* caller of
# docker/docker/client is internal/backend/docker/lifecycle.go — compose v5 and
# docker/cli v29 both moved to github.com/moby/moby/client. Porting lifecycle.go
# across is therefore worth measuring as a follow-up, but it is not a foregone
# win: buildx still reaches docker/docker via pkg/namesgenerator, and both
# advisories are module-granularity (empty ecosystem_specific), so any linkage
# may keep them called. Measure with govulncheck before assuming.
GO-2026-4887   docker/docker — no patched release (fix only in moby/moby/v2 betas)
GO-2026-4883   docker/docker — no patched release (fix only in moby/moby/v2 betas)
#
# golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp is unmaintained/frozen ("Fixed in: N/A"); its OSV
# entry has `introduced: 0` with no `fixed` event at all, so no release will
# ever clear it. fred reaches only the openpgp/armor ASCII-encoding envelope via
# cosmos-sdk keyring ExportPrivKeyArmor/ImportPrivKey
# (internal/chain/signer_pool.go), not openpgp message/signature crypto.
GO-2026-5932   x/crypto/openpgp unmaintained — reached only via cosmos-sdk keyring armor
#
# ── Category B is empty. ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# It previously deferred the containerd/buildkit fixes that sat behind the
# docker/compose v2 toolchain. ENG-642 moved fred to docker/compose v5, which
# pulls containerd v2.3.3 and buildkit v0.32.1 directly, so every entry it held
# is fixed in the selected graph and has left the called set. Do not re-add a
# blanket "compose-coupled" justification: check the requirement graph of the
# specific version you need.
